title: PACAF Fighter Simulator Instructor Pilot
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > PACIFIC AIR FORCES > FA5215  766 ESS PKP
description:
PACAF Fighter Simulator Instructor Pilot II (SIM-IP II) – Request for Information (RFI) / Sources Sought  

 The Department of the Air Force, 766th Enterprise Sourcing Squadron (766 ESS), is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of providing contractor instructor pilot and associated fighter simulator training support services for Pacific Air Forces (PACAF). 

 The anticipated requirement may include simulator instruction, academic instruction, scenario development, distributed mission operations support, training administration, and program management. 

 Potential performance locations include Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, Hawaii; Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska; Kadena Air Base and Misawa Air Base, Japan; and Osan Air Base and Kunsan Air Base, Republic of Korea. Locations and supported platforms are subject to change. 

 The Government seeks industry feedback regarding contractor capabilities, small-business participation, staffing availability, overseas performance challenges, and potential acquisition strategies. 

  This notice is for market research and acquisition planning purposes only.  It is not a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or solicitation. Responses are not considered offers, and the Government will not reimburse respondents for costs associated with preparing or submitting information. 

 Interested parties are encouraged to review the attached RFI and industry questions and submit responses in accordance with the instructions provided. 

  Response Deadline:  02 December 2026, at 2:00 PM Hawaii Standard Time (HST). 

 Requests for additional response time may be submitted to the Government Point of Contact identified in the attached RFI. Extensions may be granted at the Government’s discretion.
